description: Checkmyguest offers you a modern, three-bedroom, 101 m² apartment in the sought-after Bel-Air district of Paris' 12th arrondissement. Enjoy the utmost comfort for unforgettable stays, just a stone's throw from the charming Square Sarah Bernhardt, famous for its 200 trees, mosaic-topped bandstand and children's playground.ATTENTION VERY QUIET PROPERTYThe spaceDiscover this gem of a modern apartment nestled in the vibrant Bel-Air district, ideal for accommodating up to 8 people. Its exceptional, carefully landscaped setting offers the perfect haven for recharging your batteries. Surrounded by the Bois de Vincennes, this leafy neighborhood is a veritable urban sanctuary, dotted with quaint little streets and lively nooks and crannies that charm with every step.Every room in this apartment has been designed to combine comfort and contemporary style:➜ A cosy living room with sofa bed, ideal for relaxing or entertaining guests.➜ A fully-equipped kitchen with all the appliances you need to cook with ease.➜ A convivial dining area for sharing meals with family and friends.➜ Three bedrooms, each with a double bed, offer an oasis of tranquillity with soft beds for restful nights.➜ Two stylish and functional bathrooms with showers, offering all the comforts needed to get ready quickly or relax after a busy day.➜ Numerous optimized storage spaces to organize your belongings➜ Television and high-speed Internet (WIFI)➜ Bed linen and towels are provided by us.Guest accessYou will have access to the entire apartment, so you will feel at home.Other things to noteThis booking is protected with coverage for lost luggage and emergency medical expenses, provided by Travel Support with claim upto 750 Euros (T&C Applies). Full details are available at the time of booking.
